source_rows.observed: GEOARROW_INTERLEAVED restored Point geometry and EPSG4326/[2,1] for3.8. Four bbox attributes appeared for3.8 but not3.9. Required id/label values/order were retained. Null→EMPTY occurred in the original3.8 interleaved output too; raw Arrow geometry null_count is0 for both old and alias files.
source_rows.question_judgment: Scoped alias supported for legacy representation. Extra fields reject exact-schema consumers only; they alone do not fail a required-id/label subset consumer. Strict null-preservation requirement already failed in the old representation.
limitations: Do not count old null→EMPTY behavior as a new migration-induced loss.
An observed1.0.0 metadata string on the legacy extension is not proof of full GeoParquet1.0 conformance.
